verdict.rationale: Name.com lets users issue separate development and production API tokens from Account Settings → Security → API Tokens. Resellers can also create customer accounts with their own credentials and permissions, which gives coarse isolation an agent could use. However, the Core API authenticates with account-wide HTTP Basic credentials, and nothing documents per-token permission scopes, read-only tokens, or restricting a token to specific domains or operations. Missing for 10: per-token permission scoping, read-only or operation-limited tokens, domain-level restrictions, token expiry/rotation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
